Files.Prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET, a768x768 RPG pixel-art stone terrain transition tile. Edit ONLY the bright solid magenta center square, exactly x256..511,y256..511, keeping the entire rest of image pixel-for-pixel unchanged. Replace the magenta marker by continuing the surrounding existing blue-gray cobblestone texture. This square contains the concave inside corner of the terrain's transparent opening, which lies toward the UPPER LEFT: connect the surrounding transparent opening on the TOP and LEFT sides of this square by a small gently rounded, irregular concave inner-corner transition, with naturally feathered alpha; retain solid connected stone on the RIGHT and BOTTOM sides. The transparent portion should be confined to a small area near the UPPER LEFT of the former magenta square, rather than a big circular hole. Match the adjacent stone boundaries exactly where they meet all four edges of the magenta square: complete any stones cut by those edges, extend their dark joints and their light facets continuously, with no square seam or abrupt line. Match original cobble size, density, orientation, exact muted slate blue-gray palette and upper-left highlights. Crisp clustered pixel art with same visible pixel size as neighboring texture (roughly4 image pixels per logical pixel); do not smooth or reinvent the surrounding pattern. The terrain's transparent feather edge must follow a continuous natural bend from the existing edges outside the square, not a straight diagonal, protruding block, isolated new hole or arbitrary round patch. Remove every magenta pixel, no pink tint remains. Preserve image size, framing and the relative positions of every original stone outside the magenta area; no crop, zoom, translation, border, text, objects or grid. Transparent areas must be true alpha. Return the full edited square image.
